intro: A local MCP server that lets an AI agent read, write and search the files of the working copy its session names, and nothing outside it. `read_file`, `list_directory`, `find_files` and `search_text` read; `write_file` and `edit_file` change; `find_tool` says which of them answers a task described in words, and `run_tools` runs several of them in one call. There is no tool that deletes, moves or runs anything.
